name: model_op_fused_moe
description: SGLang fused MoE experts, unquantized path (sglang/srt/layers/moe/fused_moe_triton/fused_moe.py fused_experts / fused_experts_impl). hidden_states [num_tokens, H] float16/bfloat16, w1 [E, N, H] where N = 2 * shard_intermediate_size holds gate rows in [:N/2] and up rows in [N/2:], w2 [E, H, N/2], topk_output the StandardTopKOutput triple (topk_weights [num_tokens, topk], topk_ids [num_tokens, topk] int32, router_logits). Each token is routed to its topk experts: gate/up projection through w1[e], silu or gelu gating, down projection through w2[e], scaled by the routing weight, summed over topk, then multiplied by routed_scaling_factor. Returns a new [num_tokens, H] tensor. Quantization (fp8/int8/int4), bias, no_combine, apply_router_weight_on_input and inplace are pinned off, matching the unquantized configuration benchmarked in benchmark/kernels/fused_moe_triton.
